stories.title: Yemeni forces claim control regained over Hays district in Hodeidah province
stories.summary: Yemeni forces claim control regained over Hays district in Hodeidah province Yemeni government forces claim they have regained "complete control" of the district of Hays in the province of Hodeidah from the Houthis, Al Jazeera reported. It said government forces had recovered the areas at Al-Barah junction and advanced towards Houthi positions as the rebels retreated, killing and wounding dozens of fighters. Meanwhile, Majeed Al-Nuzayli, spokesman for the armed forces, wrote on X that "we destroyed the Houthi militia's capabilities and elements in the Al-Labnah Camp".

stories.title: US refutes PAS leader Hadi Awang’s claim of attempt to influence Malaysian politics
stories.summary: The United States has rejected Parti Islam Se-Malaysia president Hadi Awang’s claim that Washington had previously sought to influence Malaysia’s political leadership. The Charge d’Affaires at the US Embassy in Malaysia, David Gamble Jr, said the US had never sought to determine Malaysia’s political leadership. “Any account to the contrary is false,” he said in a statement on Sept 6. On Sept 5, Hadi alleged that a US Embassy representative had once asked whom PAS would propose as prime minister if the opposition party took over the Malaysian government. In his winding-up speech at the 72nd annual congress of PAS, Hadi said the meeting took place when the party was part of the Pakatan Rakyat coalition. The PAS president said a US ambassador had requested to meet him and he attended the meeting with former PAS secretary-general Mustafa Ali. “The ambassador asked, ‘Who does PAS propose as prime minister?’ I asked him back, ‘Who does America agree with?’
